title: Photo-assisted (de)lithiation to enhance photoelectrochemical storage in quasi-solid-state Li-ion batteries
content:
RSC Sustain., 2024, 2,3999-4007
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00494A, Paper
Open Access

Xin Mi, Jun Pan, Menglin Duan, Fuqiang Huang, Peng Qin
Here, we constructed a dual-functional cathode using CsPbBr3 perovskites as the photo-responsive unit and lead phytate as the ion storage unit, offering a practical and sustainable method to achieve solar-driven electrochemical energy storage.
